Indian YouTubers are not just content creators; they are business moguls. In this video, I break down how top creators like Fukra Insaan, Triggered Insaan, Ashish Chanchlani, and Bhuvan Bam are turning their massive fanbase into crore-earning brands within just 2 days.

Fokus Drink by Fukra Insaan & Triggered Insaan – What makes it unique? Pros, cons, income & marketing strategy.
OG Beauty by Ashish Chanchlani – A deep dive into his brand, sales model & future potential.
Peppy by Bhuvan Bam (BB Ki Vines) – Is it the next big thing? Success analysis & revenue breakdown.

From smart marketing to crazy fan engagement, these YouTubers have cracked the business game. Watch till the end to see how they make ₹4 Cr in just 2 days and what we can learn from their strategies.
